sentences.en: The river which flows through London is called the Thames.
sentences.zh: 流经伦敦的河叫做泰晤士河。

sentences.en: There is a constant flow of traffic on this road.
The river is flowing very fast after last night's rain.
sentences.zh: 昨晚下雨后，河水流得很快。
